catalogs.method: open official browser catalog; follow link IDs 9 through 102 in 12-target batches
catalogs.note: link IDs apply to captured response only, not a stable API; translations separately mapped

catalogs.method: open each official archive page; extract date + heading title + captured browser link ID; follow investigation headings
catalogs.note: purposive temporal sample; archive numbering differs among cached renditions

catalogs.method: open official report archive and nine titles; supplement with four official-domain historical queries
catalogs.note: archive pages 2-6 all 404 via browser; no exhaustive count inferred

copyright_policy: Raw browser text stays only /tmp. Commit metadata, rendered hash, short justified excerpt and scripts; never full report caches.
date_policy: Dates null unless recovered from original catalog/report; copyright years are not publication dates. Partial dates preserve month precision.
count_policy: PDF versions and translation mirrors do not add canonical works. Browser headers do not count as acquired text. Context-read fulltext passages are not full-document reading or original downloads.
